source_baseline_limitation: Only four production files were hashed at recovery start; all final production sources are sealed below. The older PARTIAL report lacked pre-edit source hashes.
architecture: Owned isolated executable; no TopoDS objects or native pointers cross into Gmsh or Godot. SHA-256 checked metre BREP handoff with complete unique descriptor mapping.

endurance.scope: 100 native cycles; 10 STEP imports; 10 alternating TET4/TET10 remeshes. Separate campaigns cover solver/GUI/cancellation. No universal leak-free claim.

gui_endurance.scope: Graphical parameter edits, selections, reassignments and save/reopen cycles; alternating TET4/TET10 solves every fifth cycle and on the final cycle. Not an unlimited leak-free claim.

terminate-cut.fault: TerminateProcess(77) against observed owned native Cut worker; injected termination, not an OCCT segfault

cancel-cut.fault: Cooperative job cancellation during observed native Cut

cancel-step.fault: Cooperative job cancellation during observed native STEP import

timeout.fault: Native deadline forced to zero seconds

owner-exit.fault: Terminate Godot owner while native worker is active

limitations: Supported CAE domain is one closed positive-volume solid; assemblies/contact are outside scope.
Native validation is not a guarantee against every geometric self-intersection or a guarantee of mesh success.
Modified, generated, split, merged, transformed or ambiguous faces require explicit boundary review; preservation is restricted to verified unchanged provenance.
Curved nonuniform STEP example is explicitly rejected because computed affine volume misses the invariant by 0.8615%; planar nonuniform scaling is qualified.
Coarse thin pipe meshing fails and refined settings succeed. Tiny-feature and nested-cut coarse meshing failures are retained and reported, not relabelled geometry successes.
60-cycle GUI memory and archive growth is measured; no unlimited leak-free claim. The historical Godot access violation is unresolved.
Retention applies to registered completed jobs; active, grace-period, historical, pinned and explicitly archived data are excluded. It is not an operating-system disk quota.
Crash isolation uses injected TerminateProcess(77); it does not reproduce a specific OCCT segmentation fault.
MSYS2 package PGP signatures were not verified; official HTTPS provenance and exact archive SHA-256 locks are retained.
